display.summary: An Operations panel for the deployment: check and repair it, restart services, read their logs.
highlights: Options > admin rail > Operations runs the deployment check and applies its repairs, restarts or recreates allow-listed services and shows recent logs (needs Composer 1.7.0b2+).
The Updates card keeps only what can be updated; the deployment check moved to the Operations panel.
Includes 1.13.0b1: the maintenance page moves into the Composer image (stack schema 3).
